children.game_version: A 'sliding' game where children mimic the hovering motion to reach markers.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the heel-pivot motion while seated, focusing on ankle flexibility.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the pivot with support from a sturdy chair or railing.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo to ensure stability and comfort.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Loose, fluid movements that contrast with the precise footwork.
movement_profile.footwork: Heel-pivot based movement creating a sliding effect.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Individual, moving across a flat surface.

signature_moves.description: Walking forward using the heel as a pivot to turn the back foot, creating a sliding, hovering impression.
signature_moves.name: Heel-Pivot Walk

movement_profile.tempo_feel: High-tempo, matching the pulse of electronic music.

music_profile.sound_description: Electronic music, specifically psy trance or electro house, characterized by a driving, repetitive beat that supports fluid, continuous movement.

basic_steps: Step forward with the lead foot.
Use the heel as a pivot point.
Turn the back foot backwards while the front foot turns inwards.
Repeat the motion in reverse to move backwards.
teaching.formation: Individual, typically performed in open spaces or on dance floors.
teaching.level_notes: Requires focus on heel-pivot coordination to achieve the 'hovering' effect.
teaching.rhythm: High-tempo electronic music, typically psy trance or electro house.
